title: A test requires a past start day to be saved; the journey says it never is
what: The journey for Change start date says a start day in the past must never be saved. The test of the same rule saves a start about a month back and passes, and the rule allows up to 31 days back on purpose.
expected: The journey and the test agree: either a past start is refused, or the journey says up to 31 days back is allowed.
fix_line: Decide the rule, then fix the journey line or the test

title: The WhatsApp sheet on a member page is barely tested, and never as the desk
what: One screen test opens the sheet as the owner and reads the ready message. No test sees the red box for a half mobile number, the greyed "needs internet" link, the language pick being remembered, the hand-changed text going back on reopen, or WhatsApp opening on this member's number. No test opens it signed in as the desk.
expected: A screen test for each of those, for the owner and the desk.
fix_line: Add one phone test of the sheet for the owner and one for the desk

title: Sending a workout plan from a member page is never done on screen
what: The rules behind it are tested as data: which plans are already sent, Undo, and a clash with another desk. No test opens "Send a plan" on a member page, taps Send, sees the Undo bar, the "Already sent" row, the greyed offline button or the not-online card words, for any role.
expected: A screen test that sends a plan, undoes it and sees "Already sent", as the owner, the desk and a trainer.
fix_line: Add one phone test of the Send a plan sheet

title: Parts of cancelling a membership are never checked on screen
what: The one test cancels and undoes a renewal as the owner. It never checks the "unpaid, not in dues" line on the row, the Keep it button, the Saving button, the greyed offline button, the dues tile after the cancel of a part-paid plan, or that a second cancel after an undo keeps the new reason.
expected: The test checks each of those lines.
fix_line: Extend the cancel test with a part-paid plan and a second cancel

title: No screen test taps Save twice on the money sheets of a member page
what: The rule that one press makes one receipt is tested in the data store only. No phone test checks that the Sell, Collect or Cancel receipt button reads "Saving…" or "Cancelling…" and cannot be pressed again, or that two fast taps make one sale and one receipt.
expected: A phone test double-taps each money sheet and finds one sale or receipt and the busy button.
fix_line: Add a double-tap check to the money phone tests

title: The measurements card for a gym not online, and a long list of entries, are never tested
what: No test opens a member page in a gym that is not online and checks "Put your gym online first" with no Add button. No test has five or more entries to check the full list then the newest four, or sees "Keep them" and "Deleting…".
expected: Screen tests for the not-online card and a member with five or more entries.
fix_line: Add the two cases to the measurements phone test
